transcript.content: Hi, I'm calling about reservation PEP4E0. I thought I added travel insurance when I booked my upcoming flight, but it's not showing up online. Everyone else in my family has insurance for the same trip, so I really need to get this added to my reservation.
I'll look up your reservation to check the insurance status.

I can see your reservation shows insurance as "no." Unfortunately, our policy doesn't allow travel insurance to be added after a booking is made—it can only be purchased at the time of booking. Since your reservation was created on May 5th and your flight is coming up on May 20th, adding insurance now isn't available.

I understand this is frustrating, especially since your family members have it for the same trip. The insurance option would have needed to be selected during the original booking process.

Is there anything else I can help you with regarding your reservation?

I distinctly remember selecting the insurance option when I booked, so this feels like a system error on your end. Is there really no way to correct that? Everyone in my family has coverage except me—it doesn't make sense that I'd intentionally leave myself uncovered. Can you check if there's any override or exception available?

I understand this is frustrating, but I need to be direct: our policy doesn't permit adding insurance after a booking is completed, and that applies uniformly—there are no overrides or exceptions available, even when there's a discrepancy between what you remember selecting and what the system recorded.

Your reservation record clearly shows insurance was not purchased at booking. While it's possible there was a display issue during your checkout, the booking system is the authoritative record of what was actually charged and confirmed. Unfortunately, I'm not able to retroactively add coverage or override that policy decision, regardless of what your family members have.

Your flights are coming up on May 20th. At this point, your best option would be to explore standalone travel insurance through a third-party provider if you want coverage for the remainder of your trip—though I'd recommend acting quickly given how soon you're flying.

Is there anything else I can help with on your reservation?
Okay, I understand. Thanks for checking.
